name: arn-intranet
description: Plataforma interna da ARN. Fundação local F1-01.

scripts.test:php: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist
scripts.test:identity:integration: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo wp eval-file tests/integration/identity-persistence.php --user=admin
scripts.test:oidc:integration: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo wp eval-file tests/integration/federated-session.php --user=admin
scripts.test:authorization:integration: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo wp eval-file tests/integration/authorization-persistence.php --user=admin
scripts.test:units:integration: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo wp eval-file tests/integration/local-units.php --user=admin
scripts.test:import-preview:integration: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo wp eval-file tests/integration/import-preview.php --user=admin
scripts.test:editorial:integration: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo wp eval-file tests/integration/editorial-preview.php --user=admin
scripts.test:notifications:integration: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo wp eval-file tests/integration/local-notifications.php --user=admin
scripts.test:account-sessions:integration: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo wp eval-file tests/integration/account-sessions.php --user=admin
scripts.composer:install: node scripts/wp-env.mjs --tests run cli --env-cwd=arn-repo composer install --no-interaction --no-progress --prefer-dist
